name: zine_press_core
description: Zine Press core: turns a PDF into the files for printing it at home as an A5 saddle-stitched booklet on A4 (booklet.pdf for two-sided printers, fronts + backs for one-sided ones, a one-sheet test, a printing and binding guide). Vector imposition with qpdf, optional 300 dpi flattening with PDFium.
